rulings.restated: Add f1040 line 2b and f1040 line 3b.
rulings.model: IRS line 4a includes ordinary dividends "except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends"; adding f1040 line 3b without that exclusion would include them.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the model says the restatement (Form 1040 line 2b plus line 3b, BUG-0391) includes Alaska Permanent Fund dividends. f4952 p. 3, Line 4a: "ordinary dividends (except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends)". Form 1040 line 3b is Schedule B line 6 (Form 1099-DIV ordinary dividends); Alaska Permanent Fund dividends are entered on Schedule 1 line 8g (s1.yaml; p525 p. 31, "report it as income on Schedule 1") and never reach line 3b. Same point as the earlier rulings on the Schedule B restatement.

rulings.restated: Add sb line 2 and sb line 6.
rulings.model: IRS line 4a includes ordinary dividends but 'except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends'; the restatement adds Schedule B ordinary dividends without that exception, so it can overstate line 4a.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the model says the restatement adds Schedule B ordinary dividends without the Alaska Permanent Fund exception. f4952 p. 3, Line 4a: "ordinary dividends (except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends)". Schedule B line 6 copies sb.ordinary_dividends, "Total ordinary dividends, Form 1099-DIV box 1a"; Alaska Permanent Fund dividends are not Form 1099-DIV dividends and are reported on Schedule 1 line 8g (s1.yaml, p525 p. 31, "report it as income on Schedule 1"), so they never reach line 4a. The model assumed they are in Schedule B line 6.

rulings.restated: Add sb line 2 and sb line 6.
rulings.model: IRS line 4a says 'Gross income from property held for investment includes income, unless derived in the ordinary course of a trade or business, from interest, ordinary dividends (except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends), annuities, and royalties.' The program simply adds Schedule B interest and ordinary dividends, omitting the Alaska Permanent Fund dividend exclusion.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; the model says the restatement adds Schedule B ordinary dividends without the Alaska Permanent Fund exception. f4952 p. 3, Line 4a: "ordinary dividends (except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends)". Schedule B line 6 copies sb.ordinary_dividends, the Form 1099-DIV box 1a total; Alaska Permanent Fund dividends are not Form 1099-DIV dividends and are entered on Schedule 1 line 8g (s1.yaml, p525 p. 31, "report it as income on Schedule 1"), so they never reach line 4a. Same ruling as the earlier rounds.

rulings.restated: Subtract $0 from sd line 16. If zero or less, enter -0-.
rulings.model: The IRS line is 'Net gain from the disposition of property held for investment'; the restatement uses Schedule D line 16, which is not limited to property held for investment and can include other gains or losses.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f4952 (2025) p.3 Lines4d/4e restrict disposition amounts to property held for investment. The supported ScheduleD stream is manually classified securities and fund capital-gain distributions; sales.special refuses special/nonsecurities property and sd.other_forms refuses Forms4797/6252/4684/6781/8824 and K-1 gains. f4952.unsupported at line2 screens other investment income/expenses beyond interest, dividends and securities sales. Within this declared completed-return slice the ScheduleD totals/net-capital-gain helper are the investment amounts. The broader IRS cases are excluded; the ruling does not assert that arbitrary ScheduleD amounts from an excluded return are investment-property amounts.
